site.metaTitle: SwapSpot - Peta diambuluisha dia kuitabuja pashishe ne webe
site.metaDescription: Lomba bambuluishi ba pashishe ba kuitabuja bua disukula, dilumbulula, buimpe, dilama dia mudima, dishintulula nzubu, dilama dia nyama, dilama dia bakulumpe, dilongesha ne bikuabu.
site.hero.badge: Mpindieu tudi tutuadija mu tshitupa tshiebe
site.hero.body: Lomba disukula, dilumbulula, buimpe, dilama dia mudima, dishintulula nzubu, dilama dia nyama ne bikuabu mu marshe umue wa tshitupa.
site.hero.rating: kudi bantu 2,300+ ba pashishe · bambuluishi 1,200 pashishe
site.hero.review: Ndakalomba muambuluishi wa dilumbulula pashishe ne njila mu minit 10.
site.how.title: Diambuluisha didi ku kuata 3
site.how.body: Kutuka ku "Ndi ne bua bua eu" too ku dilomba dimane, kakuyi kubikilangana pa telefone, kakuyi kuela meji, kakuyi mishinga idi kayiena mimanyike.
site.steps.0.1: Tangila bambuluishi ba kuitabuja pa karte, bapangadibua bu mudi bakule ne nota.
site.steps.1.1: Tangila profil, midimu ne mishinga idi mimanyike bimpe kumpala kua kusungula.
site.steps.2.0: Lomba, tuma mikanda ne futa mu dikuba
site.steps.2.1: Tuma mikanda, peta mushinga ne futa mu app mu dikuba.
site.helpers.title: Enza makuta ku bumanyi buebe mu muaba webe
site.helpers.body: Panga kamue ne utuadije kulombibua kudi bantu ba pashishe badi ne bua ne tshidi wenza.
site.helpers.freeTitle: Kakuyi mfutu kudi bambuluishi dituku dionso
site.helpers.freeBody: Bumba makuta onso audi upeta 100%. SwapSpot kayena uangata komisio, pesenti anyi mfutu wa dilomba.
site.perks.0.1: Funda bumanyi buebe, foto ne tshitupa tshia mudimu mu minit mikese.
site.perks.1.0: Ela mishinga yebe ne bikondo biebe
site.perks.1.1: Webe udi ulongolola mishinga, radiyi ne dipangadika.
site.perks.2.1: Peta malomba a pashishe ne andamuna ne mishinga yebe.
site.perks.3.0: Vudija avi ne balombi badi bapingana
site.perks.3.1: Peta nota idi ishintulula midimu ya kumpala bu balombi ba kabidi.
site.categories.title: Mudimu ukonso, kudi muambuluishi
site.categories.body: Kategori ya midimu ya muaba ya kumpala, ne ikuabu idi yivudila bu mudi marshe yonso yikola.
site.categories.names.specialty-seasonal: Ya pa nkayabu ne ya bikondo
site.trust.title: Yapangibua bua bonso babidi bamone dikuba
site.trust.body: Avi ya bulelela, mikanda ya bunkaya ne mapangilu adi apesha bantu luseba pa bidi biabu.
site.trustItems.0.1: Nota ya bulelela kudi bantu ba pashishe kunyima kua mudimu yonso.
site.trustItems.2.1: Manyisha anyi kanyina muntu yonso pa tshikondo tshionso.
site.trustItems.3.1: Katula konti yebe ne bidi biebe pa tshikondo tshionso tshiudi ukeba.
site.trustItems.4.1: Bambuluishi badi balongolola mushindu udi muaba wabu umueneka.
site.waitlist.title: Angata SwapSpot lelu
site.waitlist.body: Tangila bambuluishi ba pashishe kakuyi mfutu. Tumikila pase bu mudi mulongolodi bua kutuma mikanda, kulomba mishinga anyi kulomba.

site.waitlist.noSpam: Angata app, tangila bambuluishi ne tuadija bu mudi mulongolodi.

directory.indexMetaDescription: Tangila mapeji a SwapSpot a bantu bonso a midimu kutuka ku kategori ne marshe wa muaba. Peta disukula, dilumbulula, dishintulula nzubu, dilongesha, dilama dia nyama, buimpe, midimu ya bumanyi ne bikuabu.
directory.indexBadge: Mukanda wa midimu wa bantu bonso
directory.indexTitle: Midimu ya bambuluishi bu mudi kategori ne marshe
directory.indexIntro: Mapeji aa apangibua kutuka ku midimu ya bambuluishi idi mu SwapSpot. Adi abakuambuluisha balombi bua kumona bimfuanyi bia midimu bu mudi tshimenga, kodi ya poste, tshitupa, kategori, mushinga, lulimi ne nota.
directory.statPages: mapeji a kategori ne marshe adi ku mudimu
directory.statPreviewsIndexed: bimfuanyi bia midimu bia bantu bonso
directory.byCountryBody: Link yonso ya kuinshi idi ibudila peji wa bantu bonso. Pa muambuluishi upandisha tshitupa tshipia tshia mudimu, tshidi tshimueneka apa kunyima kua site kushintulula cache.
directory.emptyBody: Mukanda wa midimu upangibua kutuka ku midimu ya bambuluishi. Bu link kayidi apa mpindieu, pingana lukasa anyi ibudila app bua kutangila bambuluishi ba pashishe.
directory.pairMetaDescription: Peta bambuluishi ba {categoryLower} mu {market}. Pima bimfuanyi bia midimu, bitupa bia mudimu, mishinga, ndimi ne nota kumpala kua kuibudila SwapSpot.

directory.pairSummaryEmpty: SwapSpot udi ulongolola bimfuanyi bia bambuluishi ba {categoryLower} mu {market}. Ibudila app bua kutangila bambuluishi ba pashishe, kupima bitupa bia mudimu ne kulomba mishinga.
directory.pairSummary: Pima bimfuanyi bia midimu ya {categoryLower} ya bantu bonso kutuka kudi bambuluishi ba pashishe ne {market}. Tumikila app bu mudi mulongolodi bua kutuma mukanda, kulomba mushinga anyi kulomba.
directory.popularEyebrow: Midimu ya muaba idi bantu bakeba
directory.popularBody: Midimu eyi idi itukila ku profil ya bambuluishi, kayiena mukanda wa marketing udi kawuyi kushintulula.
directory.areaTitle: Tshitupa tshia muaba, kayiena adrese ya bulelela
directory.areaBody: Mapeji a bantu bonso adi aleja bitupa, kodi ya poste, bimenga ne radiyi wa mudimu bua balombi bapete diambuluisha dia pashishe kakuyi kuleja adrese ya bunkaya.
directory.namesTitle: Mêna a midimu adi mua kukebibua
directory.namesBody: Midimu ya bambuluishi idi ishintululibua mu mêna adi mua kukebibua, mêyi a muaba ne mapeji a kategori, bua balombi bakebe midimu ya bulelela idi ne bua.
directory.inAppTitle: Diakula ne dilomba bidi mu app
directory.inAppBody: Site udi uambuluisha bantu bua kupeta midimu. SwapSpot udi ubumba mishinga, mikanda, malomba, avi ne dikuba mu app wa telefone.
directory.faqTitle: Peji eyi wa bantu bonso udi wenza bishi
directory.pairFaq1Q: Ndi mua kulomba bambuluishi ba {categoryLower} mu {market} pa peji eyi?
directory.pairFaq1A: Peji eyi ya site idi bimfuanyi bia bantu bonso bia kupeta. Angata SwapSpot bua kutuma bambuluishi mikanda, kulomba mishinga, kutuma adrese ya bulelela ne kulongolola malomba.
directory.pairFaq2Q: Adrese ya bulelela ya bambuluishi idi ya bantu bonso?
directory.pairFaq2A: Nanku. SwapSpot udi uleja bitupa bia mudimu bia kuyi bulelela bujima bu kodi ya poste, bitupa, bimenga anyi radiyi. Adrese ya bulelela idi ya bunkaya, ne idi mua kutumibua mu diakula padi bonso babidi balongolodi.
directory.pairFaq3A: Nanku. Bambuluishi badi mua kupanga profil ne kuela midimu kakuyi komisio anyi pesenti wa SwapSpot. Balombi badi bafuta bua kupeta padi bakeba kutuma mikanda, kulomba mishinga anyi kulomba.
directory.pairListDescription: Bimfuanyi bia bantu bonso bia midimu ya {categoryLower} idi mu SwapSpot mu {market}.
directory.cardsEmptyBody: SwapSpot udi uibudila profil ya bambuluishi ba muaba bu mudi marshe. Angata app bua kumona midimu ya pashishe, kupima mishinga ne kutuma bambuluishi mikanda padi mulongolodi.
directory.cardsTitle: Bimfuanyi bia bulelela bia bambuluishi ba {categoryLower}
directory.cardsBody: Pima midimu, mishinga, bitupa, ndimi, nota ne bumanyi bua bambuluishi pashishe ne {market}. Adrese ya bulelela ne dibikila bidi mu SwapSpot.
directory.cardNoDescription: Tangila bimfuanyi bia mudimu eu mu SwapSpot, kupita ibudila app bua kutuma mukanda, kulomba mushinga anyi kulomba.

directory.profileEyebrow: Profil wa muambuluishi wa bantu bonso
directory.previewTitle: Bimfuanyi bia profil wa bantu bonso
directory.previewBody: Pima midimu apa, kupita tuma mikanda ne lomba mu app.
directory.noCommissionBody: Bambuluishi badi babumba mfutu ya midimu. SwapSpot kayena uangata pesenti anyi komisio ku mudimu wa muambuluishi.
directory.servicesBody: Aba mbimfuanyi bia midimu bimueneka bia SwapSpot. Mishinga idi mua kuikala ushindame, ola ne ola, kutuadija ku, anyi mu dilomba bu mudi mudimu.
directory.serviceFallback: Ibudila SwapSpot bua kumona mudimu eu, kulomba bidi ne kushindika tshidi mukati kumpala kua kulomba.
directory.areasBody: Mapeji a bambuluishi a bantu bonso adi apesha site ne balombi bidi ne bua: mêna a midimu, bitupa, bimenga, bitupa bia pashishe ne bilejilu bia lulimi. Bidi bia dikuata bia bulelela bidi mu SwapSpot.
directory.continueTitle: Tuma mukanda, lomba mushinga ne lomba ne dikuba dia bunkaya.
directory.helperFaq1A: Ibudila SwapSpot bua kutuma muambuluishi mukanda, kulomba mushinga, kutuma bidi bia mudimu bia bulelela ne kulongolola dilomba mu dikuba mu app.
directory.helperFaq2Q: Adrese ya bulelela idi ya bantu bonso?
directory.helperFaq2A: Nanku. Mapeji a bantu bonso adi aleja bitupa bia mudimu bia kuyi bulelela bujima bu bitupa, bimenga, kodi ya poste anyi radiyi. Adrese ya bulelela idi ya bunkaya too bantu batuma mu diakula.
directory.helperFaq3Q: SwapSpot udi uangata komisio kudi bambuluishi?
directory.helperFaq3A: Nanku. Bambuluishi badi mua kuela midimu kakuyi SwapSpot kuangata komisio anyi pesenti ku mfutu ya midimu yabu.

categories.specialty-seasonal: Ya pa nkayabu ne ya bikondo
pricing.title: Tangila kakuyi mfutu. Tumikila pase bu mudi mulongolodi bua kuenza.
pricing.body: Balombi badi mua kutangila kategori ne kupima bambuluishi kakuyi kufuta. Pase udi ne bua bua kutuma mikanda, kulomba mushinga anyi kulomba muambuluishi.
pricing.freeBody: Tangila kategori, bimfuanyi bia bambuluishi, bitupa bia mudimu ne bilejilu bia kuitabuja kumpala kua kusungula pase.
pricing.plans.0.name: Pase wa dituku
pricing.plans.0.note: Bimpe bua mudimu umue, diambuluisha dia lukasa anyi kutangila SwapSpot.
pricing.plans.1.name: Client Pro
pricing.plans.1.note: Bimpe bua bidi bia nzubu, famiye, kupangisha anyi mudimu bia dituku dionso.
pricing.plans.1.features.1: Tuma mikanda ne lomba mishinga pa tshikondo tshionso
pricing.plans.1.features.2: Mushinga muimpe kunyima kua matuku 5 adi enza
passPrice.seeStore: Tangila mushinga wa mpindieu mu App Store anyi Google Play
passPrice.referenceNote: Mushinga wa tshilejilu. App Store anyi Google Play udi uleja mushinga wa nshikidilu.
passPrice.footnote: Mushinga wa nshikidilu wa muaba ne tase bidi bimueneka kudi App Store anyi Google Play kumpala kua kulanda.
staticPages.intro: Peji eyi idi mu lulimi lusungule. Bua nkonko ya mikanda ya mpangilu anyi ya konti yebe, bikila hello@swapspot.org.
appPreview.title: Dilomba dionso, kutuka ku kutuadija too ku nshikidilu
appPreview.messageA: Moyo! Udi mua kuenza nzubu wa mabeda 2 Sam?
forClients.title: Enza mudimu kakuyi kukeba bantu kule ne kule
forClients.body: Ibudila app, mone bidi pashishe, pima profil ya bulelela, tuma mikanda mu SwapSpot ne lomba padi mumone bimpe.
forClients.cards.0.1: Keba kuenzela kategori, kule, nota ne bikondo.
forClients.cards.1.1: Tangila profil, mishinga, avi, foto ne midimu.
forClients.cards.2.1: Lomba nkonko, shindika bidi ne bumba mishinga mu mulongo.
forClients.cards.3.1: Tumikila avi, dimanyisha, dikanyina ne mapangilu a konti padi ne bua.
cookieConsent.title: Bidi usungula bua privasi
cookieConsent.body: Tudi tumikila cookie ya Google Analytics bua kumanya bapitshila ne kuvudija SwapSpot bimpe. Udi mua kuitaba anyi kubenga cookie ya analytics idi ya kusungula.
maintenance.text: SwapSpot udi uya ku server mpia. Pa ola yimue, kubuela, kushintulula dîyi dia kupita ne bishintulula bia konti bidi mua kuyi kuenza. Enza kabidi kunyima kua tshikondo.
reset.title: Shintulula dîyi diebe dia kupita
reset.intro: Sungula dîyi dia kupita dipia, kupita buela mu app ya SwapSpot ne imeyilu yebe ne dîyi dipia dia kupita.
reset.repeatPassword: Fundila kabidi dîyi dipia dia kupita
reset.done: Dîyi diebe dia kupita dishintululibua. Ibudila app ya SwapSpot ne buela.
reset.invalid: Link eyi kayiena yimpe anyi yamana tshikondo tshiayi. Lomba mpia mu app.
reset.openLink: Ibudila link wa shintulula ya mu imeyilu yebe bua kutungunuka.
reset.unavailable: Dishintulula dia dîyi dia kupita kadiena dipetibua pa site eyi mpindieu.
